wins.label: Strong Q3 Financial Results
wins.evidence: net income and diluted earnings per share, both up from a year ago and the second quarter. Revenue increased 5% from a year ago with growth in both net interest income and strong fee-based revenue

wins.label: Asset Cap Lifted - Growth Unlocked
wins.evidence: Our total assets at the end of the third quarter were over $2 trillion for the first time in the company's history. We have grown our trading-related assets in the corporate and investment banking, which are up 50% since the end of 2023

wins.label: Investment Banking Market Share Gains
wins.evidence: In investment banking, we have gained over 120 basis points of share in the U.S. since 2022, the most of any investment bank. investment banking fees increasing 25% from a year ago

wins.label: Improved Credit Performance
wins.evidence: Our credit performance was strong and continued to improve. Our net loan charge-off ratio declined 9 basis points from a year ago and 4 basis points from the second quarter

wins.label: Significant Expense Reduction & Efficiency
wins.evidence: By the end of this year, we expect to have achieved approximately $15 billion of gross expense saves. Our headcount has declined from a peak of approximately 276,000 in second quarter 2020 to approximately 211,000 in the third quarter 2025, down 24%

risks.label: Credit Card Growth Drag on Near-Term Earnings
risks.evidence: growing credit card portfolios are a drag on earnings and returns until approximately the third year before starting to add to earnings

risks.label: Consumer Business Returns Below Industry
risks.evidence: Our consumer businesses are currently generating returns below the industry

risks.label: Commercial Real Estate Office Losses Expected
risks.evidence: Office valuations continue to stabilize. And although we expect additional losses, which could be lumpy, they should be well within our expectations

risks.label: ROTCE Target Dependent on Multiple Factors
risks.evidence: Our new ROTCE target is obviously dependent on a variety of factors, including interest rates, the broader macroeconomic environment and the regulatory environment

risks.label: Commercial Bank Utilization Rates Remain Flat
risks.evidence: What we're not seeing is growth in the commercial bank yet. And really, that's just because the utilization rates and the revolvers continue to be pretty stable
